rulesHub.title: Rules
rulesHub.intro: Every rule of your shop as one plain line. Press Edit to change it: the shop follows at once.
rulesHub.search: Search rules, e.g. COD, exchange, free delivery
rulesHub.pickOne: Pick a rule to change it here.

strip.sample: {n} rules are on with the shop's own starting numbers: check them
strip.allOwn: Every rule that is on uses your own numbers
strip.showingSample: Showing the rules that still use the starting numbers.

eid.title: Eid order-by dates
eid.sentence: The last order days before Eid, and what the shop says after them.

peak.title: Peak and Eid mode
peak.sentence: Mode is {enabled}. Orders a day: {dailyCap}. Stickers in one part: {partSize}. People on the roster: {roster}.

advance.title: Advance payment
advance.sentence: When an order must pay a part first, and how many layers of rules decide it.

cod.title: Cash on delivery limits
cod.sentence: The biggest cash on delivery order and where it is allowed.

prepaid.title: Reward for paying online
prepaid.sentence: The reward is now an offer: free delivery, a percent, a flat amount. Open Offers & discounts.

autoconfirm.title: Auto-confirm
autoconfirm.sentence: Rules confirm orders by themselves: {enabled}. A customer is trusted after {trustedMinDelivered} delivered parcels and at most {trustedMaxRefused} refusals.

score.title: Courier score
score.sentence: Each order gets a score out of 10 from the customer's courier record. Bands and weights are set on the risk rules page.

dup.title: Duplicate orders
dup.sentence: Look back {lookbackDays} days for the same customer's earlier order: {enabled}. Put a clear duplicate on hold by itself: {autoHold}.

merge.title: Merge orders
merge.sentence: Merging two open orders of one customer is {enabled}. Look back {lookBackDays} days. Different addresses: {differentAddress}. Merge by itself: {autoMerge}.

adjust.title: Price adjust limits
adjust.sentence: Taking money off an open order is {enabled}. Roles with their own limit: {roleLimits}. Anyone else asks the owner.

advwait.title: Advance reminder hours
advwait.sentence: Remind a customer about the advance after {value} hours (0 means no reminder).

courier.title: Default courier
courier.sentence: Which courier parcels go to, and whether the shop picks by area.

couriermsg.title: Courier messages
couriermsg.sentence: The words sent to the courier with a booking, a cancel, a claim or a payout. Edited under Couriers.

erpcheck.title: ERP check of returned pieces
erpcheck.sentence: A returned piece is checked in the ERP within {value} days.

replace.title: Replacement for a faulty or wrong piece
replace.sentence: Replacement is {enabled}. It can be opened for {hours} hours after delivery. The old piece comes back within {oldPieceDays} days.

grades.title: Customer grades
grades.sentence: Customers get a grade from what they spent and how many parcels they took.

offers.title: Offers & discounts
offers.sentence: Offers, coupons, sale prices, points and wallet credit in one place, with what each cost and brought.

popups.title: Pop-ups & notices
popups.sentence: The shop's twelve pop-ups and notices: where each shows, who sees it, and your own words.

peak.enabled: Switch Peak and Eid mode on
peak.dailyCap: Orders a day the shop can send
peak.fullTextEn: Words when the day is full (English)
peak.fullTextBn: Words when the day is full (Bengali)
peak.partSize: Stickers in one part of Print all in parts

autoconfirm.trustedMinDelivered: Delivered parcels that make a customer trusted
autoconfirm.trustedMaxRefused: Most refusals a trusted customer may have

dup.autoHold: Put a clear duplicate on hold by itself

merge.autoMerge: Merge by itself when the addresses match

adjust.enabled: Allow price adjust on open orders

erpcheck.value: Days to check a returned piece

replace.hours: Hours after delivery it can be opened
replace.oldPieceDays: Days for the old piece to come back

rulesHub.backConfirm: Go back to the shop's starting value?
rulesHub.sampleNote: This rule is on with the shop's own starting numbers. Check them, then press Save to make them yours.
rulesHub.moneyNote: This rule changes what customers pay. It needs the owner's OK and PIN.
rulesHub.needsOwner: Only the owner can change this rule.
rulesHub.nothingYet: Nothing yet. Change a value above.
rulesHub.appliesToNew: It applies to new orders from the moment you save.

more.title: More options
more.fuller: Open the fuller page for this rule

rulesHub.emptyMeansOff: Leave empty to switch it off.

roleLimits.hint: Tick a role to give it its own limit. Leave a box empty for no limit on that side. A role not ticked asks the owner every time.

popups.title: Pop-ups & notices
popups.intro: Every pop-up and notice the shop can show, in four groups. Each row says where it appears, who sees it and when. The picture shows where every number appears.
popups.writtenBelow: Written below, in your own notices
popups.pickOne: Pick a pop-up or a number in the picture to write its words.
popups.noticeNote: This one is written in your own notices below the list: the bar and the welcome pop-up have their own timing and limits.
popups.waitingNote: This pop-up waits for demo products. It shows when they are built.
popups.managedNote: Its switch is in {rule}. Your words and dates are saved here.
popups.needsNote: This only shows while {rule} is on.
popups.lowN: Show when this many are left or fewer
popups.sampleHint: Sample values are used for the {details}.

popup.name: Welcome / offer pop-up
popup.where: Home page, a few seconds after opening

holiday.name: Holiday banner
holiday.where: Under the menu on every page
holiday.builtin: Order by {date} to get it before Eid

freebar.name: Free-delivery bar
freebar.where: In the bag, above the total
freebar.who: Customers whose bag is below the free-delivery amount

dup.name: Duplicate-order pop-up
dup.who: Customers who ordered the same item recently
dup.builtin: You ordered this {days} days ago. Add to that order {order}?

advance.name: Advance-payment notice
advance.where: Checkout, next to the payment choice
advance.who: Customers who must pay an advance
advance.builtin: Pay {amount} now to confirm this order

stockhold.name: Stock-hold notice
stockhold.where: Checkout, at the top while the customer fills the form
stockhold.who: Customers whose size is on hold
stockhold.builtin: We keep your size for {minutes} minutes

oos.name: Out-of-stock size notice
oos.who: Customers whose size was taken meanwhile
oos.builtin: Size {size} is gone. Pick another size

demo.name: Demo product "coming soon" pop-up
demo.where: Product page, when Add to bag is tapped on a demo design
demo.who: Visitors who tap a demo design

lowstock.name: Low-stock notice
lowstock.where: Product page, next to the size picker
lowstock.who: Everyone, when a size is nearly gone

thanks.name: Thank-you notice
thanks.builtin: Thank you {name}, your order {order} is placed

promise.name: Delivery promise
promise.where: Order done page, and under Order now on product pages

offers.title: Offers & discounts
offers.intro: Offers, coupons, built-in price rules, the reward for paying online, points and wallet credit in one place, with what each cost and brought. Nothing goes live without the owner's OK and PIN.

tabHint.all: Everything running, scheduled, paused or waiting.
tabHint.calendar: Offers with dates, in the order they start.
tabHint.awaiting: Offers sent for the owner's OK.
tabHint.history: Offers that have ended. They stay for good.

kindHint.FREE_DELIVERY: The delivery charge is not taken.
kindHint.FLAT: A fixed taka amount off the order.
kindHint.WALLET_CREDIT: Credit put in the customer's wallet.

offers.resultsNote: Orders, discount given, delivered value and returns are counted from the orders that used the code. An offer without a code, points and wallet show a dash.

trigger.label: When does it apply
trigger.onlineHint: This is the reward for paying online. It applies to every online payment, with no code, scope, dates or limits.

value.freeDelivery: The delivery charge is not taken. Nothing else to set.

where.label: Applies to
where.onlineAll: The reward for paying online applies to every order paid online.

who.label: Who can use it
who.onlineAll: The reward for paying online is for every customer who pays online.

offers.codeHint: Empty: it applies by itself. Who can use it and the limits of use need a code.

when.onlineNow: The reward for paying online has no dates: it runs while it is live.

limits.budgetHint: A note for you: the offer is not stopped by it.
limits.onlineNone: The reward for paying online has no limits of its own.

preview.title: What you are about to make
preview.ok: Nothing stops this offer. It can be sent for the owner's OK.
preview.noName: Give the offer a name first.
preview.needsOk: Saving makes a draft. Sending asks the owner; only the owner's OK and PIN make it live.

issues.BAD_WINDOW: The end is before the start.
issues.OFFER_ENGINE_PENDING: Points and wallet credit offers cannot go live yet: the job that gives them is not built. You can keep this as a draft.
issues.ONLINE_NEEDS_ALL: The reward for paying online takes no scope, code, dates or limits.
issues.ONLINE_KIND: Paying online can give free delivery, a percent or a flat amount, not points or wallet credit.
issues.WHO_NEEDS_CODE: Limiting who can use it needs a coupon code.
issues.LIMITS_NEED_CODE: Limits of use need a coupon code.
issues.MIN_ORDER_FREE_DELIVERY_CODE: Free delivery with a code cannot have a smallest order. Remove the code or the amount.
issues.ONLINE_REWARD_TAKEN: A reward for paying online is already on. Pause it first.

detail.title: Offer
detail.endConfirm: End this offer for good? It stays in the history.

offers.savedNotSent: Saved as a draft, but not sent: {why}
